title: Digital Finance Strategy and Policy
summary: Brings the programme together to examine how tokenisation, stablecoins and DeFi affect a jurisdiction's digital finance strategy, and how authorities can balance innovation with effective risk management.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: Brings the programme together to examine how tokenisation, stablecoins and DeFi affect a jurisdiction's digital finance strategy, and how authorities can balance innovation with effective risk management.
Learning Objectives: Explain the trends shaping the future of digital finance
Compare regulatory approaches and international standards across jurisdictions
Evaluate policy options, supervisory capability and resourcing needs
Syllabus: Comprehensive crypto-asset regimes, convergence and divergence across jurisdictions
International standards: FSB, IOSCO, FATF and the Basel Committee
Institutional adoption, stablecoins in payments and tokenised infrastructure
Workshop: balancing growth, market integrity and supervisory capability
Intended Audience: Supervisors and authorisation staff responsible for, or moving into, oversight of virtual asset service providers
Risk, policy, legal and financial crime specialists working on digital finance
Senior managers shaping the authority's approach to crypto-assets and digital finance
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Some experience of financial supervision, authorisation or financial crime work is helpful. No technical background in blockchain or crypto-assets is required.
Core Reading: FSB, High-level Recommendations for the Regulation, Supervision and Oversight of Crypto-Asset Activities and Markets (2023)
IOSCO, Policy Recommendations for Crypto and Digital Asset Markets (2023)
FATF, Updated Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Virtual Assets and Virtual Asset Service Providers (2021)
Basel Committee, Prudential Treatment of Cryptoasset Exposures (2022)
